The main takeaway from our work is that
the jet profile is not only modified, but also shifted towards lower transverse momenta, and that the shift is larger for jets with a smaller opening angle.
the jet profile is not a simple convolution of a parton-level profile with a transport function, but rather a complicated function of the jet profile and the transport function.
